ff-judging-distance-ran-1.back: About 20 cm low with a 100 m zero: under the heart or a leg.

ff-judging-distance-ran-2.front: How does a laser rangefinder measure?
ff-judging-distance-ran-2.back: It times a light pulse to the target and back.

ff-judging-distance-ran-9.front: Second focal plane reticle ranging rule?
ff-judging-distance-ran-9.back: Only at the power the manual names, usually the highest.

ff-judging-distance-ran-10.back: Picture a known 100 m and count how many fit. Not accurate past 400 m.

ff-judging-distance-ran-12.front: Name 3 things that make a deer look nearer.

ff-judging-distance-ran-16.front: How do you learn your pace count?
ff-judging-distance-ran-16.back: Walk a measured 100 m three times counting each left foot; average it.
